import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==expected, (name,got,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before, name+' mutated inputs'

check('missing', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'z':1}}, [], {'required_conditions':['z','a']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a']})
check('absent-not-zero', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'x'}}, [{'source':'s','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':0}}], {'required_conditions':['mode','calibration']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
check('verified-filter-before-supersede', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None}}, [{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':False,'supersedes':['old']}], {'required_conditions':['mode','calibration'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})
check('eligible-supersede', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'x'}}, [{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x'}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'mode':'x'},'supersedes':['old']}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check('typed-conflict', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'x'}}, [{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x'}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('withdrawn-and-wrong-claim', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'x'}}, [{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x'},'withdrawn':True},{'source':'b','claim':'d','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed')
